message: Recently you contacted R.J.Reynolds'Consumer Relations Department and gave us the opportunity to respond to your request for assistance with either a promotion or product related issue. In an effort to better serve our customers,we are asking you to please take a few minutes to complete a questionnaire about how well you were treated by our company representative.After completing the survey on the reverse side of this letter,please retum it in the enclosed postage-paid envelope. Please return within ten days of receipt.
